bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Bookkeeping on a run file; computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which pending hypotheses of a research run should never run?

description: Withdraw a research run's pending hypotheses (all of them, or the ones named) so no resume runs them, and return the sealed run file. Nothing is deleted: a canceled hypothesis stays registered and still counts in e-BH with e 1, because it was registered before any result and dropping it would raise the others' chance of support after the fact. Answered and settled hypotheses cannot be canceled. To stop a run that is advancing in budgeted slices, stop calling resume_research_run; cancel when the pending hypotheses should never run.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

hypotheses.description: the pending hypotheses to cancel, by id; unset cancels every pending one.

reason.description: why, recorded on each canceled attempt.

run.description: the run file to cancel pending hypotheses in.

name: cancel_research_run

run.description: the whole program as a sealed jane.research-run file: the ledger, every corpus input pinned by SHA-256, the last attempt at each hypothesis. Pass it back to continue

status.description: the canceled run's status: counts, pending (now none of the canceled), settled and canceled hypotheses
